integrity.proof_basis: Clader--Damiolini--Li--Ramadas Theorem 4.13 and a proved universal strict-interlacing induction
integrity.reproducibility: Exact integer cross-checker included; checks finite cases only

scientific_limitations: For a fixed primitive-root connected component over the complex numbers; no claim on arbitrary wonderful compactifications, cohomology ring multiplication, or equivariance. Relies on the published corrected ordered-jump Chow decomposition. No independent audit.
title: Strict interlacing and negative zeros for Betti polynomials of cyclic rational-curve compactifications
